name: SolidInserts
summary: Create heat-set insert seats and captive hex nut pockets in existing holes.
description: Select circular hole rims to cut seats for heat-set inserts or internal pockets for DIN 934 hex nuts. Captive Nut Pockets can estimate print pause heights and save the build-plate face for Send to Slicer. The cuts stay editable in the SolidCraft timeline.
